protocol.null: Simple undirected degree-preserving edge swaps, conditioned on connected output.
protocol.metric: Remaining articles outside the largest component after removing one named article and all its incident edges.
protocol.selection: Exploratory: Spider-Man is the highest-degree article. Hulk contrasts a large hub; Black Widow was chosen after inspecting all single-node removals; Doctor Strange is a second large hub with stranded neighbors.
protocol.limitations: Finite edge-swap chains approximate a null ensemble; longer-run sensitivity is a diagnostic, not proof of uniform sampling. Tail estimates are descriptive, unadjusted across the four displayed cases. Links are article links, not friendships, readership or resilience of a fictional universe.
